name: cram
description: Turn any document into an interactive flashcard quiz in a single self-contained HTML file. Extracts normalized cards — basic, multiple choice and cloze — then renders an offline quiz that remembers your progress and lets you retry only what you missed.

interface.shortDescription: Turn source material into offline flashcard quizzes
interface.longDescription: Create validated basic, multiple-choice, and cloze flashcards from source material, then render a self-contained offline quiz with hints, scoring, review, retry-missed-only mode, and persisted progress.
